a, b, limit = map(int, input().split())

import math

min_difference = 1e9
numerator_result = 0
denominator_result = 1

def lcm(x, y):
    return x * y // math.gcd(x, y)

if b <= limit:
    g = math.gcd(a, b)
    while g > 1:
        a //= g
        b //= g
        g = math.gcd(a, b)
    print(f"{a}/{b}")
else:
    for i in range(1, limit + 1):
        l = lcm(i, b)
        w = a * (l // b)
        diff1 = abs(w - ((w // (l // i)) * (l // i))) / l
        if min_difference > diff1:
            min_difference = diff1
            numerator_result = w // (l // i)
            denominator_result = i
        num = w + (l // i) - 1
        den = l // i
        diff2 = abs(w - ((num // den) * den)) / l
        if min_difference > diff2:
            min_difference = diff2
            numerator_result = num // den
            denominator_result = i
    g = math.gcd(numerator_result, denominator_result)
    numerator_result //= g
    denominator_result //= g
    print(f"{numerator_result}/{denominator_result}")
